description: The guest wing with its west wall curving in, three chords 3 feet deep, so the footprint has three reflex corners, and every edge but the north eave a gable overhanging a foot: the eave outline moves each chord out a foot and is narrower there than the footprint's corners, but each gable end still stands on its own chord of the footprint and rises to the plane over it (16.5).
